messages:
Ava: quick sync — planning to roll out the "Emerald Wave" welcome series for the benchmark webinar cohort. goal: 3-email drip over 7 days, APAC send-window adjustments, and lead-source-aware content. tags: webinar-reg, docs-download, api-trial. any blockers?
Priya: I can set the flow. confirm the triggers: immediate welcome on reg, day3 best-practices, day7 webinar reminder? also want to add a backfill for people who registered but never got onboarding emails.
Sam: yes to that cadence. For APAC we should shift send windows to 10am-2pm local, and for NA keep 9am-12pm. throttling: cap per minute to 200 for initial burst.
Ben: Content notes — second email (day3) should surface the benchmark snapshot + 1-pager download. third email is webinar reminder + CTAs to book dedicated demo. I'll drop copy drafts into the campaign doc.
Jo: Analytics checklist: utm_campaign=emerald-wave, utm_source=welcome-drip, event names: welcome_email_open, welcome_click_benchmark, webinar_rsvp_from_drip. We'll track cohort conversion at 7d and 14d.
Priya: Segment definitions so ops knows exact picks:
```
- cohort: users where lead_source in ("webinar-reg","docs-download","api-trial") and created_at >= "2026-03-01"
- backfill: registered=true AND last_email_sent IS NULL AND registered_at >= "2025-12-01"
- control: random 10% holdout per lead_source for measurement
```
Ava: love the control idea. we want holdout for quality/regression checks. Sam — subject line test plan?
Sam: propose A/B for email1: A) "Welcome — your Redwood benchmark snapshot" B) "You’re in — start faster with Redwood inference". Use 50/50 split within each lead_source segment; measure open->click at 48h.
Ben: subject variants look good. Also recommend preview text test: focus on latency vs cost.
Jo: Reminder: include user_id hashed in tracking link to join cross-platform cohort mapping. We'll need the mapping by March 30.
Priya: Ops checklist: templates ready, tests passing in staging, suppression list checked (do-not-email + unsubscribed). Setting suppression to include recent bounces. ETA to schedule: today if copy is final.
Ava: Copy is about 80% — ben will finish by noon. Priya, can you backfill the ~1.2k missed regs overnight? separate job or same flow?
Priya: will run backfill as a separate job to avoid skewing analytics. run after the main launch, low-rate sends. will tag with backfill=true.
Ben: dropped links: https://docs.redwood.ai/emerald-benchmark and webinar landing https://redwood.ai/events/emerald-wave. Using the short link for email: rwd.ai/emerald
Sam: tiny ask — include an optional block for enterprise customers (dedicated capacity CTA). we can target api-trial lead_source for that block.
Ava: good call. Ben add that copy as a conditional content block.
Jo: I'll create the cohort dashboard and set alerts if conversion deviates >20% vs baseline.
send-bot: Campaign "emerald-wave-welcome" scheduled: start=1767894600, rate=200/min, segments=3, backfill_job=queued.
Ava: :thumbsup: launching after Ben finalizes copy. post-launch sync tomorrow 9am PT to review first 24h metrics.
